ns2:section.sectionText: Speculative Futures: Our future is—and has always been—uncertain. In this course we’ll read science fiction and speculative fiction by some of your favorite authors: Margaret Atwood, China Mieville, Philip K. Dick, Max Brooks, George Saunders and many more. Students will have the opportunity to branch out into film, TV shows, graphic novels, and video games. Our goal is to consider the following questions: what do our visions of the future tell us about the state of the world—historically and in the present day? What kinds of questions, ideas, and problems motivate the future? What roles does technology play in these visions? Who gets to construct our future and why?
